purpose: v0.2 ORACLE task-scoped authority: upper bounds assuming a perfect trusted planner, not deployable defenses

authority.source: User-task ground_truth() on an isolated clean task-initialized environment, before any attack injection

argument_policy.rule: Match all fixed arguments from at least one complete ground-truth call; no cross-product of independently allowed values
argument_policy.fixed: All supplied literal arguments, including dates, subjects, read limits and literal message bodies
argument_policy.free: Omitted ground-truth arguments; body equal to '<summary>' or '...' only in send_direct_message/send_channel_message ground truth
argument_policy.missing_proposal_arguments: Use trusted tool-schema defaults where present, without coercing explicitly supplied values
argument_policy.numeric_equality: Equal int/float JSON numbers; booleans and strings never coerced

receipts.prompt_manifest: Audit-only deterministic render required by receipt v1; no model queried; 0/1 values encode policy outcomes, not probabilities
